person: Developed-country parties to the Copenhagen Accord
promise: The Accord committed developed countries to provide new and additional resources approaching $30 billion over 2010-2012.
description: Donors reported over $33 billion in fast-start finance, but independent assessment questioned additionality. Reported totals alone do not establish fulfillment of every condition.
evidence: The Accord specifies new and additional resources and balanced allocation between adaptation and mitigation.
Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: reported aggregate funding does not resolve additionality or allocation conditions.
